## Module 07. 差异 Peak 的功能富集分析

对差异 Peak 关联的基因进行 GO 和 KEGG 富集分析。

这一节的逻辑顺序固定为：

1. 差异 peak 注释到基因。
2. 以配置得到的 comparison-reference 作为主富集口径，并按可及性方向拆分子集。
3. 构建 peak-derived 背景基因集，保存 GO / KEGG / compareCluster 全量结果表。
4. 绘图与主要展示固定按原始 `pvalue < 0.05` 临时过滤；缺少原始 pvalue 时标为不可用，不回退校正列。`p.adjust`/qvalue 继续保留为补充诊断。
5. 最后基于临时过滤结果绘制 barplot、dotplot、treeplot、cnetplot 和 compareCluster 图；若输入不足或无显著条目，则写 skipped-state。

```{r peak_gene_enrichment_cache_gate, include=FALSE}
if(isTRUE(reuse_step_tables) && file.exists(cache_07_peak_gene_enrichment_state_path)) {
  load_state("07_peak_gene_enrichment_state.rds", env = globalenv(), required = TRUE)
  cache_has_group_comparison_enrichment <- exists("diff_anno_df") &&
    is.data.frame(diff_anno_df) &&
    nrow(diff_anno_df) > 0 &&
    exists("gene_membership_tbl") &&
    is.data.frame(gene_membership_tbl) &&
    nrow(gene_membership_tbl) > 0 &&
    exists("go_results") &&
    exists("kegg_results") &&
    file.exists(step_table_file("Step7", "Annotated_DiffPeaks.csv")) &&
    (!isTRUE(atac_enable_liftover_related_gene_annotation) ||
       file.exists(step_table_file("Step7", "DifferentialPeak_RelatedGenes_liftOver_mm10ToMm39_EnsemblGTF.csv"))) &&
    file.exists(step_table_file("Step7", "DifferentialPeak_Associated_Genes.csv")) &&
    file.exists(step_table_file("Step7", "Peak_Gene_Enrichment_Input_Summary.csv"))
  if(isTRUE(cache_has_group_comparison_enrichment)) {
    report_status(
      "INFO",
      paste(
        "Reusing cached peak-gene enrichment state for module 7:",
        cache_07_peak_gene_enrichment_state_path,
        "(set ATAC_REUSE_STEP_TABLES=false to recompute)"
      )
    )
    knitr::knit_exit()
  }
  report_status("WARN", "Existing peak-gene enrichment cache lacks group-comparison enrichment state; recomputing module 7.")
}
```

```{r enrichment}
enrichment_plot_files <- function(prefix) {
  c(
    paste0(prefix, "_barplot.pdf"),
    paste0(prefix, "_dotplot.pdf"),
    paste0(prefix, "_treeplot.pdf"),
    paste0(prefix, "_cnetplot.pdf")
  )
}

compare_plot_files <- function(prefix) {
  c(paste0(prefix, "_dotplot.pdf"), paste0(prefix, "_barplot.pdf"))
}

remove_step6_table <- function(file_name) {
  unlink(file.path(step6_table_dir, file_name), force = TRUE)
}

write_enrichment_plot_skip <- function(prefix, reason, compare = FALSE) {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step7",
    prefix,
    reason,
    clear_plot_files = if(compare) compare_plot_files(prefix) else enrichment_plot_files(prefix)
  )
}

resolve_ensembl_txdb_sqlite <- function(gtf_file) {
  candidates <- c(
    Sys.getenv("ATAC_ENSEMBL_TXDB_SQLITE", unset = ""),
    sub("\\.gtf$", ".gtf.sqlite", gtf_file),
    paste0(gtf_file, ".sqlite")
  )
  candidates <- candidates[nzchar(candidates)]
  hits <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if(length(hits) > 0) hits[1] else ""
}

read_ensembl_txdb_sqlite_feature_table <- function(gtf_file) {
  sqlite_file <- resolve_ensembl_txdb_sqlite(gtf_file)
  if(!nzchar(sqlite_file)) {
    handle_nonfatal(
      paste("Ensembl TxDb SQLite was not found for liftOver related-gene annotation. GTF:", gtf_file),
      step = "Step7"
    )
    return(data.frame())
  }
  if(!requireNamespace("DBI", quietly = TRUE) || !requireNamespace("RSQLite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    handle_nonfatal("Packages DBI and RSQLite are required for TxDb-SQL related-gene annotation.", step = "Step7")
    return(data.frame())
  }

  con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), sqlite_file)
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con), add = TRUE)

  tx <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "select * from transcript") %>%
    transmute(
      tx_id = as.integer(`_tx_id`),
      transcript_id = tx_name,
      seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(tx_chrom),
      strand = tx_strand,
      start = as.integer(tx_start),
      end = as.integer(tx_end)
    )
  gene <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "select * from gene") %>%
    transmute(gene_id = gene_id, tx_id = as.integer(`_tx_id`))
  exon <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "select * from exon") %>%
    transmute(
      exon_id = as.integer(`_exon_id`),
      seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(exon_chrom),
      strand = exon_strand,
      start = as.integer(exon_start),
      end = as.integer(exon_end)
    )
  cds <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "select * from cds") %>%
    transmute(
      cds_id = as.integer(`_cds_id`),
      seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(cds_chrom),
      strand = cds_strand,
      start = as.integer(cds_start),
      end = as.integer(cds_end)
    )
  splicing <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "select * from splicing") %>%
    transmute(
      tx_id = as.integer(`_tx_id`),
      exon_rank = as.integer(exon_rank),
      exon_id = as.integer(`_exon_id`),
      cds_id = as.integer(`_cds_id`)
    )

  tx_gene <- tx %>% inner_join(gene, by = "tx_id")
  gene_symbol_map <- tryCatch(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = unique(tx_gene$gene_id),
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL")
    ) %>%
      distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      transmute(gene_id = ENSEMBL, gene_name = SYMBOL),
    error = function(e) data.frame(gene_id = character(), gene_name = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  tx_gene <- tx_gene %>%
    left_join(gene_symbol_map, by = "gene_id") %>%
    mutate(gene_name = ifelse(is.na(gene_name) | !nzchar(gene_name), gene_id, gene_name))

  gene_ranges <- tx_gene %>%
    group_by(gene_id, gene_name, seqnames, strand) %>%
    summarise(gene_start = min(start), gene_end = max(end), .groups = "drop")

  tx_features <- tx_gene %>%
    transmute(seqnames, start, end, strand, feature = "transcript", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id)
  exon_features <- splicing %>%
    inner_join(exon, by = "exon_id") %>%
    inner_join(tx_gene %>% dplyr::select(tx_id, gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id), by = "tx_id") %>%
    transmute(seqnames, start, end, strand, feature = "exon", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id)
  cds_features <- splicing %>%
    filter(!is.na(cds_id)) %>%
    inner_join(cds, by = "cds_id") %>%
    inner_join(tx_gene %>% dplyr::select(tx_id, gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id), by = "tx_id") %>%
    transmute(seqnames, start, end, strand, feature = "CDS", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id)

  cds_bounds <- cds_features %>%
    group_by(transcript_id) %>%
    summarise(cds_start = min(start), cds_end = max(end), .groups = "drop")
  utr_base <- exon_features %>%
    inner_join(tx_gene %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id, tx_strand = strand), by = "transcript_id") %>%
    inner_join(cds_bounds, by = "transcript_id")

  utr_features <- bind_rows(
    utr_base %>%
      filter(tx_strand == "+", start < cds_start) %>%
      transmute(seqnames, start = start, end = pmin(end, cds_start - 1L), strand, feature = "five_prime_utr", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id),
    utr_base %>%
      filter(tx_strand == "-", end > cds_end) %>%
      transmute(seqnames, start = pmax(start, cds_end + 1L), end = end, strand, feature = "five_prime_utr", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id),
    utr_base %>%
      filter(tx_strand == "+", end > cds_end) %>%
      transmute(seqnames, start = pmax(start, cds_end + 1L), end = end, strand, feature = "three_prime_utr", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id),
    utr_base %>%
      filter(tx_strand == "-", start < cds_start) %>%
      transmute(seqnames, start = start, end = pmin(end, cds_start - 1L), strand, feature = "three_prime_utr", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id)
  )

  gene_body_features <- gene_ranges %>%
    transmute(seqnames, start = gene_start, end = gene_end, strand, feature = "gene", gene_id, gene_name, transcript_id = NA_character_)
  up2k_df <- gene_ranges %>%
    transmute(
      seqnames,
      start = ifelse(strand == "+", pmax(1L, gene_start - 2000L), gene_end + 1L),
      end = ifelse(strand == "+", gene_start - 1L, gene_end + 2000L),
      strand,
      feature = "Up2K",
      gene_id,
      gene_name,
      transcript_id = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    filter(start >= 1, end >= start)
  down2k_df <- gene_ranges %>%
    transmute(
      seqnames,
      start = ifelse(strand == "+", gene_end + 1L, pmax(1L, gene_start - 2000L)),
      end = ifelse(strand == "+", gene_end + 2000L, gene_start - 1L),
      strand,
      feature = "Down2K",
      gene_id,
      gene_name,
      transcript_id = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    filter(start >= 1, end >= start)

  bind_rows(gene_body_features, tx_features, exon_features, cds_features, utr_features, up2k_df, down2k_df) %>%
    mutate(
      gene_biotype = NA_character_,
      transcript_biotype = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    filter(start >= 1, end >= start) %>%
    distinct()
}

annotate_diff_peaks_after_liftover <- function(diff_input, chain_file, gtf_file) {
  if(!isTRUE(atac_enable_liftover_related_gene_annotation)) return(data.frame())
  if(!file.exists(chain_file)) {
    handle_nonfatal(paste("mm10-to-mm39 chain file not found; skip liftOver related-gene annotation:", chain_file), step = "Step7")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  if(!requireNamespace("rtracklayer", quietly = TRUE)) {
    handle_nonfatal("Package rtracklayer is required for liftOver related-gene annotation.", step = "Step7")
    return(data.frame())
  }

  diff_input <- standardize_diff_peak_df(diff_input) %>%
    filter(!is.na(seqnames), !is.na(start), !is.na(end), start >= 1, end >= start) %>%
    mutate(SourcePeakIndex = dplyr::row_number())
  if(nrow(diff_input) == 0) return(data.frame())

  source_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = diff_input$seqnames, ranges = IRanges(start = diff_input$start, end = diff_input$end))
  keep_idx <- as.logical(seqnames(source_gr) %in% paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y")))
  source_gr <- source_gr[keep_idx]
  if(length(source_gr) == 0) return(data.frame())
  source_gr$SourcePeakIndex <- diff_input$SourcePeakIndex[keep_idx]

  chain <- rtracklayer::import.chain(chain_file)
  lifted_list <- rtracklayer::liftOver(source_gr, chain)
  lifted_counts <- S4Vectors::elementNROWS(lifted_list)
  if(sum(lifted_counts) == 0) {
    handle_nonfatal("No differential peaks mapped through mm10-to-mm39 liftOver.", step = "Step7")
    return(data.frame())
  }

  lifted_gr <- unlist(lifted_list, use.names = FALSE)
  lifted_gr$SourcePeakIndex <- rep(source_gr$SourcePeakIndex, lifted_counts)
  lifted_gr$LiftOverMapIndex <- sequence(lifted_counts)

  gtf_features <- read_ensembl_txdb_sqlite_feature_table(gtf_file)
  if(nrow(gtf_features) == 0) return(data.frame())
  feature_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = gtf_features$seqnames, ranges = IRanges(start = gtf_features$start, end = gtf_features$end))
  S4Vectors::mcols(feature_gr) <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(gtf_features[, setdiff(colnames(gtf_features), c("seqnames", "start", "end")), drop = FALSE])

  hits <- findOverlaps(lifted_gr, feature_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
  if(length(hits) == 0) return(data.frame())

  hit_tbl <- data.frame(
    SourcePeakIndex = lifted_gr$SourcePeakIndex[queryHits(hits)],
    LiftOverMapIndex = lifted_gr$LiftOverMapIndex[queryHits(hits)],
    LiftedChr = as.character(seqnames(lifted_gr))[queryHits(hits)],
    LiftedStart = start(lifted_gr)[queryHits(hits)],
    LiftedEnd = end(lifted_gr)[queryHits(hits)],
    Feature = as.character(S4Vectors::mcols(feature_gr)$feature[subjectHits(hits)]),
    GeneID = as.character(S4Vectors::mcols(feature_gr)$gene_id[subjectHits(hits)]),
    Gene = as.character(S4Vectors::mcols(feature_gr)$gene_name[subjectHits(hits)]),
    TranscriptID = as.character(S4Vectors::mcols(feature_gr)$transcript_id[subjectHits(hits)]),
    GeneBiotype = as.character(S4Vectors::mcols(feature_gr)$gene_biotype[subjectHits(hits)]),
    TranscriptBiotype = as.character(S4Vectors::mcols(feature_gr)$transcript_biotype[subjectHits(hits)]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  yes_no <- function(x) ifelse(isTRUE(x), "YES", "NO")
  related_tbl <- hit_tbl %>%
    group_by(SourcePeakIndex, LiftOverMapIndex, LiftedChr, LiftedStart, LiftedEnd, GeneID, Gene, GeneBiotype) %>%
    summarise(
      TranscriptIDs = paste(sort(unique(TranscriptID[!is.na(TranscriptID) & nzchar(TranscriptID)])), collapse = ";"),
      TranscriptBiotypes = paste(sort(unique(TranscriptBiotype[!is.na(TranscriptBiotype) & nzchar(TranscriptBiotype)])), collapse = ";"),
      FeatureTypes = paste(sort(unique(Feature)), collapse = ";"),
      CDS = yes_no(any(Feature == "CDS")),
      Intron = yes_no(any(Feature %in% c("gene", "transcript")) && !any(Feature %in% c("exon", "CDS", "five_prime_utr", "three_prime_utr"))),
      UTR3 = yes_no(any(Feature == "three_prime_utr")),
      UTR5 = yes_no(any(Feature == "five_prime_utr")),
      Exon = yes_no(any(Feature == "exon")),
      Up2K = yes_no(any(Feature == "Up2K")),
      Down2K = yes_no(any(Feature == "Down2K")),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  source_tbl <- diff_input %>%
    dplyr::select(
      SourcePeakIndex,
      Chr = seqnames,
      Start = start,
      End = end,
      peak_id,
      peak_id_join,
      Fold,
      pvalue,
      FDR,
      PrimaryDiffPeak,
      DiffPeakClass,
      DiffDirection
    )

  related_tbl %>%
    left_join(source_tbl, by = "SourcePeakIndex") %>%
    mutate(
      AnnotationSource = "mm10 coordinates lifted to mm39; Ensembl GRCm39 GTF related-gene overlap",
      ChainFile = chain_file,
      GTFFile = gtf_file
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Chr, Start, End, peak_id, peak_id_join, LiftedChr, LiftedStart, LiftedEnd, LiftOverMapIndex,
      GeneID, Gene, GeneBiotype, TranscriptIDs, TranscriptBiotypes, FeatureTypes,
      CDS, Intron, UTR3, UTR5, Exon, Up2K, Down2K,
      Fold, pvalue, FDR, PrimaryDiffPeak, DiffPeakClass, DiffDirection,
      AnnotationSource, ChainFile, GTFFile
    ) %>%
    arrange(Chr, Start, End, Gene)
}

if(nrow(res_df) > 0) {
  cat("Preparing differential peaks...\n")
  diff_peak_source <- paste("Step5 primary", primary_diff_peak_label())
  diff_input <- filter_diff_peaks(res_df, mode = "primary") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(seqnames), !is.na(start), !is.na(end))

  diff_peaks <- GRanges()
  if(nrow(diff_input) > 0) {
    diff_peaks <- diff_peak_granges(diff_input)
  }

  save_step_table(
    data.frame(
      Source = diff_peak_source,
      ResDfRows = nrow(res_df),
      Step5OfficialTableRows = nrow(step5_official_res_df),
      DiffInputRows = nrow(diff_input),
      DiffPeakRangesBeforePrimaryChrFilter = length(diff_peaks),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    "Step7",
    "Peak_Gene_Enrichment_Input_Summary.csv"
  )

  if(length(diff_peaks) == 0) {
    cat("No peaks passed the threshold, skip enrichment.\n")
    write_skipped_state("Step7", "Peak_Gene_Enrichment", paste("No Step5 primary differential peaks passed", primary_diff_peak_label(), "."))
  } else {
    diff_peaks <- keep_primary_chromosomes(diff_peaks)
    if(length(diff_peaks) == 0) {
      cat("No primary-chromosome peaks remained for enrichment.\n")
      write_skipped_state("Step7", "Peak_Gene_Enrichment", "No primary-chromosome Step5 differential peaks remained for enrichment.")
    } else {
      cat("Annotating peaks...\n")
      txdb_step6 <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.refGene
      diff_anno <- annotatePeak(diff_peaks, TxDb = txdb_step6, tssRegion = c(-2000, 2000), annoDb = "org.Mm.eg.db")
      diff_tbl <- as.data.frame(diff_anno)
      colnames(diff_tbl) <- make.unique(colnames(diff_tbl), sep = "_dup")
      if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(diff_tbl) && !"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(diff_tbl)) {
        colnames(diff_tbl)[colnames(diff_tbl) == "SYMBOL"] <- "geneSymbol"
      }
      if(!"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(diff_tbl)) {
        diff_tbl$geneSymbol <- NA_character_
      }
      diff_metric_tbl <- diff_input %>%
        dplyr::select(peak_id_join, Fold_join = Fold, FDR_join = FDR, pvalue_join = pvalue) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(peak_id_join, .keep_all = TRUE)
      coalesce_numeric_columns <- function(df, cols) {
        out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
        for(col in cols) {
          if(col %in% colnames(df)) {
            out <- dplyr::coalesce(out, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]])))
          }
        }
        out
      }
      diff_tbl <- diff_tbl %>%
        mutate(
          seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(seqnames),
          peak_id_join = canonical_peak_id(seqnames, start, end)
        ) %>%
        left_join(diff_metric_tbl, by = "peak_id_join")
      diff_tbl$Fold <- coalesce_numeric_columns(diff_tbl, c("Fold", "Fold_join"))
      diff_tbl$FDR <- coalesce_numeric_columns(diff_tbl, c("FDR", "FDR_join"))
      diff_tbl$pvalue <- coalesce_numeric_columns(diff_tbl, c("pvalue", "pvalue_join"))
      diff_tbl <- diff_tbl %>%
        dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("Fold_join", "FDR_join", "pvalue_join"))) %>%
        mutate(
          Comparison = contrast_label,
          Direction = direction_factor(Fold),
          AnalysisRole = "comparison_reference_differential_peak",
          DiffSet = diff_peak_source
        )
      diff_anno_df <- diff_tbl
      save_csv_df(diff_tbl, file.path(step6_table_dir, "Annotated_DiffPeaks.csv"))

      if(isTRUE(atac_enable_liftover_related_gene_annotation)) {
        liftover_related_gene_tbl <- annotate_diff_peaks_after_liftover(
          diff_input = diff_input,
          chain_file = atac_mm10_to_mm39_chain_file,
          gtf_file = atac_ensembl_gtf_file
        )
        if(nrow(liftover_related_gene_tbl) > 0) {
          save_csv_df(
            liftover_related_gene_tbl,
            file.path(step6_table_dir, "DifferentialPeak_RelatedGenes_liftOver_mm10ToMm39_EnsemblGTF.csv")
          )
          liftover_related_gene_summary_tbl <- liftover_related_gene_tbl %>%
            group_by(Chr, Start, End, peak_id, peak_id_join, LiftedChr, LiftedStart, LiftedEnd, Fold, pvalue, FDR, DiffDirection) %>%
            summarise(
              RelatedGeneCount = dplyr::n_distinct(GeneID),
              RelatedGenes = paste(sort(unique(Gene[!is.na(Gene) & nzchar(Gene)])), collapse = ";"),
              RelatedGeneIDs = paste(sort(unique(GeneID[!is.na(GeneID) & nzchar(GeneID)])), collapse = ";"),
              RelatedFeatures = paste(sort(unique(FeatureTypes[!is.na(FeatureTypes) & nzchar(FeatureTypes)])), collapse = ";"),
              .groups = "drop"
            )
          save_csv_df(
            liftover_related_gene_summary_tbl,
            file.path(step6_table_dir, "DifferentialPeak_RelatedGene_Summary_liftOver_mm10ToMm39_EnsemblGTF.csv")
          )
          cat("liftOver mm10->mm39 Ensembl GTF related peak-gene rows:", nrow(liftover_related_gene_tbl), "\n")
        } else {
          write_skipped_state(
            "Step7",
            "LiftOver_RelatedGene_Annotation",
            "No liftOver mm10-to-mm39 Ensembl GTF related-gene annotations were generated."
          )
        }
      } else {
        write_skipped_state(
          "Step7",
          "LiftOver_RelatedGene_Annotation",
          "ATAC_ENABLE_LIFTOVER_RELATED_GENE_ANNOTATION is false; native mm39 peaks were annotated directly without mm10-to-mm39 liftOver."
        )
      }

      get_clean_ids <- function(ids) {
        if(is.list(ids)) ids <- unlist(ids)
        ids <- as.character(ids)
        ids <- trimws(ids)
        ids <- ids[!is.na(ids) & ids != ""]
        unique(ids)
      }

      pfos_entrez <- get_clean_ids(diff_tbl$geneId[diff_tbl$Fold > 0])
      wt_entrez <- get_clean_ids(diff_tbl$geneId[diff_tbl$Fold < 0])
      diff_entrez <- get_clean_ids(diff_tbl$geneId)

      gene_membership_tbl <- bind_rows(
        data.frame(Comparison = contrast_label, Direction = comparison_open_label, AnalysisRole = "directional_subset", ENTREZID = pfos_entrez, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
        data.frame(Comparison = contrast_label, Direction = reference_open_label, AnalysisRole = "directional_subset", ENTREZID = wt_entrez, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
        data.frame(Comparison = contrast_label, Direction = "All-differential", AnalysisRole = "comparison_set", ENTREZID = diff_entrez, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      )
      save_csv_df(gene_membership_tbl, file.path(step6_table_dir, "DifferentialPeak_Associated_Genes.csv"))

      all_peaks_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(peaks_list, function(p) {
        peak_gr <- keep_primary_chromosomes(p)
        if(length(peak_gr) == 0) return(character(0))
        anno <- annotatePeak(peak_gr, TxDb = txdb_step6, verbose = FALSE)
        as.data.frame(anno)$geneId
      })))
      all_peaks_genes <- get_clean_ids(all_peaks_genes)
      save_csv_df(data.frame(ENTREZID = all_peaks_genes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                  file.path(step6_table_dir, "Background_Peak_Associated_Genes.csv"))

      cat(contrast_label, "differential peak-associated genes:", length(diff_entrez), "\n")
      cat(comparison_open_label, "directional subset genes:", length(pfos_entrez), "\n")
      cat(reference_open_label, "directional subset genes:", length(wt_entrez), "\n")
      cat("背景基因集大小 (所有 peaks 关联基因):", length(all_peaks_genes), "\n")

      go_ontologies <- c("BP", "MF", "CC", "ALL")
      enrichment_sets <- list(
        list(key = gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", contrast_label), label = contrast_label, genes = diff_entrez, role = "comparison set"),
        list(key = "comparison_open", label = comparison_open_label, genes = pfos_entrez, role = "directional subset"),
        list(key = "reference_open", label = reference_open_label, genes = wt_entrez, role = "directional subset")
      )

      for(set_info in enrichment_sets) {
        gene_vec <- set_info$genes
        for(ont in go_ontologies) {
          prefix <- paste0("GO_", set_info$key, "_", ont)
          out_file <- paste0(prefix, ".csv")
          if(length(gene_vec) < 5) {
            remove_step6_table(out_file)
            write_enrichment_plot_skip(prefix, paste("Fewer than five genes were available for GO", ont, "enrichment in the", set_info$label, set_info$role, "."))
            next
          }
          go_raw <- run_go_enrichment(gene_vec, set_info$label, ont, universe_genes = all_peaks_genes)
          if(is.null(go_raw)) {
            remove_step6_table(out_file)
            write_enrichment_plot_skip(prefix, paste("GO", ont, "enrichment returned no result for the", set_info$label, set_info$role, "."))
            next
          }
          save_csv_df(go_raw, file.path(step6_table_dir, out_file))
          go_results[[paste(set_info$key, ont, sep = "_")]] <- go_raw
          if(nrow(as.data.frame(filter_enrich_result(go_raw, p_cutoff = 0.05))) > 0) {
            plot_enrichment_suite(
              go_raw,
              prefix = prefix,
              title = paste("GO", ont, "Enrichment -", set_info$label, set_info$role),
              plot_dir = step6_plot_dir
            )
          } else {
            write_enrichment_plot_skip(prefix, paste("GO", ont, "enrichment for the", set_info$label, set_info$role, "had no terms with raw pvalue < 0.05."))
          }
        }
      }

      for(set_info in enrichment_sets) {
        gene_vec <- set_info$genes
        prefix <- paste0("KEGG_", set_info$key)
        out_file <- paste0(prefix, ".csv")
        if(length(gene_vec) < 5) {
          remove_step6_table(out_file)
          write_enrichment_plot_skip(prefix, paste("Fewer than five genes were available for KEGG enrichment in the", set_info$label, set_info$role, "."))
          next
        }
        kegg_raw <- run_kegg_enrichment(gene_vec, set_info$label, universe_genes = all_peaks_genes)
        if(is.null(kegg_raw)) {
          remove_step6_table(out_file)
          write_enrichment_plot_skip(prefix, paste("KEGG enrichment returned no result for the", set_info$label, set_info$role, "."))
          next
        }
        save_csv_df(kegg_raw, file.path(step6_table_dir, out_file))
        kegg_results[[set_info$key]] <- kegg_raw
        if(nrow(as.data.frame(filter_enrich_result(kegg_raw, p_cutoff = 0.05))) > 0) {
          plot_enrichment_suite(
            kegg_raw,
            prefix = prefix,
            title = paste("KEGG Enrichment -", set_info$label, set_info$role),
            plot_dir = step6_plot_dir
          )
        } else {
          write_enrichment_plot_skip(prefix, paste("KEGG enrichment for the", set_info$label, set_info$role, "had no pathways with raw pvalue < 0.05."))
        }
      }

      if(length(pfos_entrez) > 5 && length(wt_entrez) > 5) {
        gene_list <- stats::setNames(list(pfos_entrez, wt_entrez), c(comparison_open_label, reference_open_label))

        cat("Running GO comparison...\n")
        ck_go_raw <- tryCatch(
          compareCluster(
            geneCluster = gene_list,
            fun = "enrichGO",
            OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
            ont = "BP",
            universe = all_peaks_genes,
            pvalueCutoff = 1,
            qvalueCutoff = 1
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            cat("GO comparison failed:", e$message, "\n")
            NULL
          }
        )
        if(is.null(ck_go_raw)) {
          remove_step6_table("GO_Compare.csv")
          write_enrichment_plot_skip("GO_Compare", "GO compareCluster returned no result.", compare = TRUE)
        } else {
          save_csv_df(ck_go_raw, file.path(step6_table_dir, "GO_Compare.csv"))
        }
        if(!is.null(ck_go_raw) && nrow(as.data.frame(filter_compare_cluster_result(ck_go_raw, p_cutoff = 0.05))) > 0) {
          plot_compare_cluster_suite(
            ck_go_raw,
            prefix = "GO_Compare",
            title = "GO Enrichment Comparison",
            plot_dir = step6_plot_dir
          )
        } else if(!is.null(ck_go_raw)) {
          write_enrichment_plot_skip("GO_Compare", "GO compareCluster had no terms with raw pvalue < 0.05.", compare = TRUE)
        }

        cat("Running KEGG comparison...\n")
        ck_kegg_raw <- tryCatch(
          compareCluster(
            geneCluster = gene_list,
            fun = "enrichKEGG",
            organism = "mmu",
            universe = all_peaks_genes,
            pvalueCutoff = 1,
            qvalueCutoff = 1
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            cat("KEGG comparison failed:", e$message, "\n")
            NULL
          }
        )
        if(is.null(ck_kegg_raw)) {
          remove_step6_table("KEGG_Compare.csv")
          write_enrichment_plot_skip("KEGG_Compare", "KEGG compareCluster returned no result.", compare = TRUE)
        } else {
          save_csv_df(ck_kegg_raw, file.path(step6_table_dir, "KEGG_Compare.csv"))
        }
        if(!is.null(ck_kegg_raw) && nrow(as.data.frame(filter_compare_cluster_result(ck_kegg_raw, p_cutoff = 0.05))) > 0) {
          plot_compare_cluster_suite(
            ck_kegg_raw,
            prefix = "KEGG_Compare",
            title = "KEGG Enrichment Comparison",
            plot_dir = step6_plot_dir
          )
        } else if(!is.null(ck_kegg_raw)) {
          write_enrichment_plot_skip("KEGG_Compare", "KEGG compareCluster had no pathways with raw pvalue < 0.05.", compare = TRUE)
        }
      } else {
        remove_step6_table("GO_Compare.csv")
        remove_step6_table("KEGG_Compare.csv")
        write_enrichment_plot_skip(
          "GO_Compare",
          paste0("GO compareCluster requires both directional subsets to have more than five genes; ", comparison_open_label, "=", length(pfos_entrez), ", ", reference_open_label, "=", length(wt_entrez), "."),
          compare = TRUE
        )
        write_enrichment_plot_skip(
          "KEGG_Compare",
          paste0("KEGG compareCluster requires both directional subsets to have more than five genes; ", comparison_open_label, "=", length(pfos_entrez), ", ", reference_open_label, "=", length(wt_entrez), "."),
          compare = TRUE
        )
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("没有显著差异的 Peak，跳过富集分析。\n")
  write_skipped_state("Step7", "Peak_Gene_Enrichment", "No Step5 differential peaks were available.")
}
```

## 6.1 废弃：单样本 Peak 相关基因富集

本模块不生成单样本 GO/KEGG 富集结果。富集口径固定为配置所得的两组比较主差异 peak，并可按两个可及性方向子集解释。
